user.title: Zero Home
user.description: Link this Home Assistant to your Zero account. Zero then controls your home from anywhere, and the home gets its own address https://<your username>.home.<domain> — no router settings, no domain of your own.

menu_options.login: Sign in with my Zero account (recommended)

login.title: Sign in with your Zero account
login.description: Use the same username and password you sign in to Zero with. The home's address will be your username: https://<username>.home.<domain>. Your plan must include the smart home.

data_description.username: Exactly as you sign in to Zero.
data_description.admin_api: Leave as it is unless Zero support told you otherwise.

code.title: Activation code
code.description: Enter the activation code from your Zero account page (My account → Smart home → Zero Home). It looks like ZH-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX, is valid for 24 hours and works once.

data_description.code: Lowercase letters and spaces are fine.
data_description.admin_api: Leave as it is unless Zero support told you otherwise.

reauth_confirm.title: Link this home again
reauth_confirm.description: Zero stopped this link (the key was replaced or revoked, or the subscription no longer includes Zero Home). Sign in again with your Zero username and password — or enter a new activation code instead.

error.invalid_format: This is not an activation code. It looks like ZH-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX.
error.rejected: Zero did not accept the code: {server_message}
error.code_invalid: Zero does not know this code. Check it on your account page.
error.code_used: This code was already used. Create a new one on your account page.
error.code_expired: This code has expired (codes are valid for 24 hours). Create a new one.
error.plan: Your Zero subscription does not include Zero Home. {server_message}
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait an hour and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Zero. Check this Home Assistant's internet connection and try again.
error.bad_answer: Zero answered in an unexpected way. Try again later or contact Zero support.
error.invalid_auth: Wrong Zero username or password. Use the same account you sign in to Zero with.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Zero Home is already set up. One home per Home Assistant.
abort.already_configured: Zero Home is already set up.

init.title: Zero Home options
init.description: Choose what Zero may see and control, and how this home is reached from outside.

data.expose_mode: What Zero may see and control
data.remote_ui: Allow the Home Assistant web interface through the link
data.set_external_url: Set Home Assistant's external URL to the public address (the official mobile apps then work from anywhere)

select.title: Chosen entities
select.description: An entity is visible to Zero when it is in one of the chosen areas, OR of one of the chosen domains, OR has one of the chosen labels, OR is listed.

external_url.title: Replace the external URL?
external_url.description: Home Assistant's external URL is already {current}. Replace it with {public_url}?

data.replace_external_url: Replace it with the Zero Home address

error.nothing_selected: Choose at least one area, domain, label or entity.

options.select: Only the areas, domains, labels or entities I choose

ui_not_ready.title: Zero Home: allow the forwarded address
ui_not_ready.description:
The web interface through Zero Home needs Home Assistant to trust this integration as a proxy, so it sees the real address of whoever connects from outside. Add these lines to `configuration.yaml` and restart Home Assistant:

```yaml
{yaml}
```

Voice control and Zero's control of your devices work without it.

link_revoked.title: Zero Home: the link was stopped
link_revoked.description: Zero no longer accepts this home's key (it was revoked or replaced by a newer activation). Open Settings → Devices & services → Zero Home and enter a new activation code from your Zero account page.

plan_ended.title: Zero Home: subscription does not include it
plan_ended.description: Your Zero subscription no longer includes Zero Home, so the link is stopped. Renew or upgrade the subscription, then enter a new activation code in Settings → Devices & services → Zero Home.

relay_unreachable.title: Zero Home: cannot reach the Zero relay
relay_unreachable.description: This Home Assistant has not been able to reach the Zero relay for more than 30 minutes (last error: {error}). Check the internet connection; the integration keeps retrying on its own.

external_url_conflict.title: Zero Home: external URL already set
external_url_conflict.description: Home Assistant's external URL is {current}, so Zero Home did not change it to {public_url}. To use the Zero Home address in the mobile apps, open the Zero Home options and confirm the replacement.
